_doc: Known EA script errors that fire without our code (ScriptError_*.xml / ErrorTrap). Matched by exception type + the top stack frames in order (suffix of 'Namespace.Type:Method'); a stack with any frame outside EA game script (Sims3.Gameplay*, Sims3.SimIFace, Sims3.UI, ScriptCore, System) never matches. Matched errors are reported as 'known EA error <id> (ignored)' and counted, never dropped. Loader + matcher: tools/harness/known-script-errors.ts.

errors.why: EA WeddingCeremony.CleanUp dereferences null when the route to the wedding arch fails (InteractionQueue DeQueue -> CleanupInteraction -> OnRouteFailed -> Situation.Exit), lot Sparkling Sands in the Baseline-IP save; fires at random after load, with and without our fixes [verified: 27 probe-out runs from 2026-10-12, before the v0.1.6 hotfix; all frames EA]
evidence: hotfix gate job ip-hf-matrix reload case, 2026-10-25
